{{Top|leg}}
The '''broadened chamber''' was a [[firing chamber]] customization for certain [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons that widened the energy beam, resulting in an increase in damage. The Mark I, II, and III versions in turn allowed for considerable boosts in the potential for a critical injury.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
